If set to _no_, the focused container will retain focus, if there are no other containers in the direction. If set to _yes_, focus will be wrapped to the opposite edge of the container, if there are no other containers in the direction. If set to _force_, focus will be wrapped to the opposite edge of the container, even if there are other containers in the direction. If set to _workspace_, focus will wrap like in the _yes_ case and additionally wrap when moving outside of workspaces boundaries. If set to _stay_, there will be no wrapping, and the focus container will retain focus even if there are other containers in the direction. Default is _no_.
